---
name: Scientific correction (MetaLab Academy)
about: A lesson, calculator, claim or resource is wrong, outdated or misleading
labels: scientific-correction
---
**Where** (lesson/module number, calculator, claim id, resource)

**Exact text that is wrong or unsupported** (quote)

**What you believe is correct and the source** (DOI/URL, section/page; say whether you read the full text)

**Your qualification relevant to this topic** (optional; no reviewer is assumed expert unless stated)

**Severity** (misleading to a learner / minor / typo)

Corrections are recorded in `metalab/corrections.json` with date and reason; nothing is silently changed.
